response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), s AS (SELECT arcref, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT arcref, cnt AS qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation FROM s ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Projects are those appearing in scanqc (projects with no QC records are excluded); the average share is taken across these projects, so it equals 1 divided by the number of projects.
Ties in deviation are broken arbitrarily, since the request gives no tie-breaker.
